note: A 200 whose body is valid JSON and is NOT this wire — what a proxy, a rewritten route or a changed API answers when it is not MiniMax's chat completion at all. It has no `choices`, so nothing can be read out of it. A FAULT that says what arrived, which is a different failure from a body that is not JSON (a gateway's HTML) and a different one again from a body that is this wire and reports a refusal in `base_resp`. DOCUMENTED SHAPE: this repository has never seen this answered, and it is here because the text step must fail on it rather than answering "no text" (S-112, S-126).

body.detail: this body parses and is not a chat completion
